memory.title_zh: AMDGPU TLB invalidate completion 与 BO lifetime
memory.title_en: AMDGPU TLB invalidate completion and BO lifetime
memory.impact_zh: 把 PTE publish、TLB issue/completion、access drain 与 BO reuse 建成显式 lifetime contract。
memory.impact_en: Model PTE publish, TLB issue/completion, access drain and BO reuse as an explicit lifetime contract.

virt.impact_zh: 将 IOMMU/BAR/revocation/peer access 从 capability query 推进到 executable validation。
virt.impact_en: Move IOMMU/BAR/revocation/peer access from capability query to executable validation.

ras.impact_zh: reset scope 与 guilty object 解耦，并明确 queue→pipe→engine→full reset 的升级梯度。
ras.impact_en: Decouple reset scope from guilty-object assumptions and define queue→pipe→engine→full reset escalation.

multi.title_zh: VFIO P2P DMA executable test matrix
multi.title_en: VFIO P2P DMA executable test matrix
multi.impact_zh: P2P capability matrix 后应增加 RAM↔BAR、BAR↔BAR、roundtrip、revoke 等真实 DMA 验证。
multi.impact_en: Add real RAM↔BAR, BAR↔BAR, roundtrip and revoke validation after the P2P capability matrix.

obs.impact_zh: profiler session 需要 desired/submitted/applied generation，并在 GFXOFF/reset/resume 后 reconcile。
obs.impact_en: Profiler sessions need desired/submitted/applied generations and reconciliation across GFXOFF/reset/resume.
